newsitem.title: UK: UK grain futures lower, tender reaction mixed.
newsitem.headline: UK grain futures lower, tender reaction mixed.

text.p: LIFFE wheat and barley futures closed lower on Thursday with mixed reactions to the weekly European Union (EU) grain tender.
A strong pound sterling kept the pressure on wheat futures with traders calling the EU tender result neutral.
The EU granted licences for 332,500 tonnes of free market wheat at 6.90 ECU's.
"It's something but not enough," said one trader.
"The result is encouraging but the restitutions could have been higher," said another.
Traders saw the barley result as bearish.
"Barley was nowhere near enough and this can only keep the bearish trend going," said one trader.
Licences for 63,500 tonnes of free-market barley were granted at 31 ECU's.
Wheat closed 0.90 to 1.25 stg down after trading 488 lots while barley finished 0.85 to 1.25 stg lower on a turnover of 253 lots.
Traders said the bulk of the barley business appeared to be rolling forward of positions with 124 lots traded in November and 120 lots in January the remaining nine lots were traded in March.
Amsterdam milling wheat futures were neglected.
UK cash traders reported a slow day with must players sidelined ahead of the tender result.
